**Apple's FY2024 gross margin: $180,683 million.**

Supporting detail from the filing:
- Total net sales for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 were $391,035 million, cost of sales was $210,352 million, and gross margin was $180,683 million [DOC-1].
- That implies a gross margin rate of approximately 46.2% ($180,683 ÷ $391,035).

Note on comparability: the question asks for a single period, so no cross-period or cross-entity comparability issue arises. For context only, the prior-year comparative in the same filing shows gross margin of $169,148 million on net sales of $383,285 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 [DOC-1] — an increase of $11,535 million (about 6.8%) year over year. Be aware that the two fiscal years end on different dates (September 28, 2024 vs. September 30, 2023), so the periods may not cover an identical number of weeks; the excerpt provided does not state the week counts.

ANSWER: $180,683 million (approximately 46.2% of net sales)
